title: Bill No. 6237/2025 establishing the National System for AI Development, Regulation and Governance (SIA)
title_original: Projeto de Lei nº 6.237, de 2025 – Institui o Sistema Nacional para Desenvolvimento, Regulação e Governança de Inteligência Artificial
summary: Executive branch bill sent to the Chamber of Deputies in December 2025 to set up the institutional side of AI regulation. It creates the SIA, headed by a Brazilian AI Council (CBIA) of ministers and the ANPD, with advisory committees for industry and civil society (CRIA) and for experts (CECIA). The ANPD would issue binding general AI rules (e.g. algorithmic impact assessments, incident reporting) and act as residual regulator where no sectoral regulator exists, while sectoral authorities keep powers in their fields. Since April 2026 it is processed jointly with PL 2338/2023 in the Chamber's special committee.
key_obligations: Create CBIA council plus CRIA and CECIA advisory committees
ANPD to issue general rules on impact assessments and serious incident reporting
ANPD acts as residual AI regulator where no sectoral regulator exists
Sectoral authorities may define further high-risk uses with the ANPD
Sandboxes run by sectoral regulators must be notified to the ANPD
